title: Real Sociedad vs Bournemouth: European debut and pressure in the League
seoTitle: Real Sociedad vs Bournemouth: European debut & pressure
subtitle: Opening classic in the Europa League league phase sees the Basque side seeking a response while Bournemouth plays its first continental match
excerpt: Real Sociedad host Bournemouth on Thursday, September 17, in the Europa League league phase 2026/27.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Real Sociedad and Bournemouth meet this Thursday, September 17, at 4 p.m. (Brasília time) at Anoeta Stadium for the opening round of the Europa League league phase 2026/27. The clash is highlighted because it marks Bournemouth's historic debut in European competitions and gives Real Sociedad a chance to bounce back after a 3‑0 loss to Atlético Madrid.

What sparked the interest in the duel

The heavy defeat to Atlético Madrid increased the pressure on Real Sociedad, which has only two wins in its last five matches across all competitions. The Basque club, currently 12th in LaLiga with seven points, is looking for an immediate answer on the continental stage.

Confirmed line‑ups and absences

For Real Sociedad, Pellegrino Matarazzo is expected to line up a 4‑4‑2 with Unai Marrero; Luken Beitia, Jon Martín, Mamadou Sarr and Sergio Gómez; Héctor Fort, Yangel Herrera, Beñat Turrientes and Ander Barrenetxea; Mikel Oyarzabal and Orri Óskarsson. Jon Aramburu is suspended, while Igor Zubeldia, Pablo Marín and Álvaro Odriozola remain unavailable due to injuries.

For Bournemouth, Marco Rose’s likely 4‑4‑2 is: Djordje Petrovic; Adam Smith, James Hill, António Silva and Adrien Truffert; Rayan, Tyler Adams, Alex Scott and Marcus Tavernier; Justin Kluivert and Evanilson. Confirmed absences are Julián Araujo, Veljko Milosavljevic, Junior Kroupi and Amine Adli.

Tactical context and expected strategies

Real Sociedad usually prioritises possession and short passing, using two holding midfielders to sustain the centre and free Oyarzabal up front. The lack of Odriozola on the right flank may push the team to concentrate actions on the left side and through the centre.

Bournemouth, under Rose, relies on high pressing and quick transitions. The attack, led by Brazilian Evanilson, aims to reach the final third frequently, although the defence still shows vulnerability, having conceded in every official match of the season.

Odds and market expectations

In Brazilian bookmakers, a Real Sociedad win is priced at 2.90, a draw at 3.50 and a Bournemouth victory at 2.30. The market also shows over 2.5 goals at 1.73 and both teams to score at 1.60, reflecting the uncertainty of a fixture without a direct history.

Broadcast and officiating

The match will be broadcast by ESPN, Disney+ and CazéTV (YouTube). The main referee will be Paweł Raczkowski, assisted by Marcin Boniek and Adam Kupsik, with fourth official Patryk Gryckiewicz and VAR Tomasz Kwiatkowski.
